Experimental feature testing in progress, please pay attention to the comments

The C change (throttling the warning) is fine, but the commit message describes behavior that already exists in the parent compression patch rather than what this change actually does. This also disables compression for encrypted files without adding a positive test that such a file is written uncompressed — it instead excludes sanity-sec test_66. Consider adding coverage for the encrypted+compressed write path.

commit.subject: LU-10026 sec: disable compression for encrypted files
commit.message:
LU-10026 sec: disable compression for encrypted files

In case a read-modify-write io pattern is carried out on a compressed
file, it has to be handled on server side.
But because encryption cannot be done on server side for security
reasons, we are not able to handle that kind of io pattern if the file
is encrypted + compressed.
So just disable compression for all encrypted files.

Test-Parameters: forjanitoronly
Signed-off-by: Sebastien Buisson <sbuisson@ddn.com>
Signed-off-by: Marc Vef <mvef@whamcloud.com>
Change-Id: I84881fb1235f015d022751d4cce2d43a7231c2b4
